title: the Ninefold Court Rising Revisited
author: Freya Okonkwo
blurb: Xanthe Marchetti, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
